Find the area $A$ bounded between the curve $x=5{y}^{4}+3$, the $y$-axis, and the lines $y=0$ and $y=1,$ as shown above. Do not round the answer.

$A=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
To find the area, we compute the corresponding definite integral, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ={\int }_{c}^{d}x(y)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(5{y}^{4}+3)\,\text{d}y \\  & =5{\int }_{0}^{1}{y}^{4}\,\text{d}y+3{\int }_{0}^{1}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={y}^{5}\,{|}_{0}^{1}+3y\,{|}_{0}^{1} \\  & =({1}^{5}-{0}^{5})+3(1-0) \\  & =1+3 \\  & =4\end{aligned}
$$
